verdict.rationale: Ramp's reimbursements page says employees in more than 70 countries and 40 currencies can be paid in their local currency within two days. Because this sits inside Ramp's native reimbursement flow (employees submit requests via web or mobile, and admins approve them in the same system), no separate international payments process is needed. Missing for 10: detailed docs on FX rates, fees, and how foreign payouts are set up, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of international payouts.
